title: 632. N-ary Tree Postorder Traversal

examples.explanation: Children come before their parent, left to right.
Every subtree is fully listed before its root.

hints: Rebuild the tree from the bracket string with a queue first.
Walk depth-first, emitting a node only after all its children.
An empty input yields an empty list.
Adaptation: the N-ary Node input is encoded as a level-order string; output maps to int_list.
